Core Values

Values that bring us together

How We Bring Value To Clients

As an organization, we are focused on understanding our customers’ needs, doing high quality work and delivering great value to help them to succeed.

How We Get Ahead In The Game

We work hard. But we also work smart. We believe that it’s important to innovate, finding better ways to do things, learning new tools and techniques, adopting new processes and improving continually.

How We Treat Our Employees

Our employees are our biggest strength. Our growth is tied to the growth of our employees. We treat each employee well and with respect, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, ethnicity or social standing. We provide a stable, safe, supportive and growth - oriented environment to our employees.

How We Communicate

We ensure that our employees and customers have access to key information at the right time so that they can make the best decisions.

How We Spend Money

We believe in responsible resource and money management. We want to spendon right things and for right reasons to get best value.

Employee Perks

Supporting your journey, every step of the way

Opportunity To Work

02

Comprehensive
Rewards Package

Enjoy competitive pay, performance bonuses, NPS, subsidized meals, travel allowances, and flexible work models.

03

Your Health
Matters

Medical insurance for your family, accidental cover, term insurance, and mental health support through our EAP, plus 26 annual leaves and year - end time off.

04

Family Care

We offer special leaves for birthdays, anniversaries, maternity, paternity, and compassionate leave to support you through life’s ups and downs.

05

Ongoing Learning &
Development

Access our InGame Academy, DISHA e - learning portal, and special education assistance for continuous growth.

Working at Lakshya

Hear it from our Team

Lakshya is full of great people doing amazing work, collaborating, and lifting each other up. This an amazing place to work!

Vlad Kulchitskiy

Seattle

Joining Lakshya has really been like joining a big family. There have been rough times but we all muddled through and grew closer together. As I’ve started to get to know more and more people over the years, every new project now feels like a family reunion where we’re all excited to work together again. I’m so proud of what we’ve accomplished together and watching people around me grow!

Megan Herod

London

Working at Lakshya has given me the opportunity to collaborate on a wide range of projects with incredibly talented individuals across various disciplines. The environment here not only fosters teamwork but also encourages continuous learning, making every project a rewarding experience.

Mansi Negi

Gurgaon

Working at Lakshya is amazing because it offers the opportunity to work on a wide range of games while maintaining a good work-life balance. It’s a place where we can develop our skills as artists and experience a true sense of accomplishment.

Indranil Ghosh

Pune

I have been with Lakshya for over six years, and my experience has been incredibly positive. As a working mother, I greatly appreciate the opportunity to work full-time from home, which allows me to manage my professional responsibilities while also attending to my personal commitments. I am grateful for the supportive environment here, especially the guidance and assistance provided by my seniors, which has been instrumental in my growth and success within the company.

Amita Mithilesh Thorvat

Pune

Working at Lakshya Digital has been an incredible journey! The creative energy here is unmatched, with every project offering a new challenge and afresh opportunity to grow. As someone who values organization, I particularly appreciate Lakshya’s structured, process-driven decision-making.

Mudasir Naqshbandi

Bangalore

What truly makes Lakshya special for me is the sense of family that permeates throughout the company. The work culture is truly amazing—collaborative, supportive, and always open to new ideas. Lakshya is also full of opportunities to work on multiple exciting projects. It’s a place where I feel valued, motivated, and continually inspired to push my creative boundaries.

Lokendra Shekhawat

Gurgaon
